description: Managing the outgoing data streams (telemetry, logs, errors, events, user streams): their bindings to providers and the peers subscribed to them.

commands.label: Create a stream
commands.description: Creates a user connector: a stream named by its byte, with what it keeps of what comes in.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The new connector: any byte but 0x00, 0x05 and a system connector's

fields.label: Keeps
fields.description: What it keeps of what comes in: nothing, the last message, or every message in order

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_FLAG_URGENT: its frames go first on every way out; SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_FLAG_FORWARD: what comes in goes out on the other targets

fields.label: Buffer
fields.description: Bytes of its buffer: the largest message kept (latest) or the ring (queue); 0 when it keeps nothing

commands.label: Remove a stream
commands.description: Removes a user stream, its subscriptions and its bindings.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector to remove

commands.label: Bind to a provider
commands.description: Binds a stream to a provider (a BLE characteristic, a UART port): its frames go there as they are, and what comes in on the provider is kept by the stream.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector

fields.label: Link
fields.description: Which driver made the provider (UART, BLE)

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Its address on that link: BLE the characteristic's 16-bit UUID, UART the port

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: SYS_DATA_CONNECTOR_BIND_RX / _TX: which way the binding carries

commands.label: Unbind from a provider
commands.description: Removes a binding; the provider is free again. Link 0: every binding of the stream.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector

fields.label: Link
fields.description: Which driver made the provider (UART, BLE)

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Its address on that link: BLE the characteristic's 16-bit UUID, UART the port

commands.label: Suspend a stream
commands.description: Stops sending frames on a stream (they are dropped without blocking the sender).

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector to suspend

commands.label: Resume a stream
commands.description: Sends the frames of a suspended stream again.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector to resume

commands.label: List the streams
commands.description: Returns every connector, its state, its subscribers and its bindings.

returns.label: Number of connectors
returns.description: Then, per connector: its head (id, keeps, flags, buffer u16, state, subscriber count, binding count), its subscribers (peer u8, dropped u16), its bindings (provider id, flags u8, dropped u16).

commands.label: Read what came in
commands.description: The message a stream kept: the last one (latest, left in place) or the oldest (queue, taken out), with its count, how many were lost and the provider it came from. Nothing kept: no bytes.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector

returns.description: The message's head, then its bytes (to the end of the frame)

fields.label: Count
fields.description: Messages come in so far, this one counted

fields.label: Length
fields.description: Bytes of the message that follow

fields.label: Missed
fields.description: Messages lost since the last read

fields.label: Cut
fields.description: 1 when the message was longer than the buffer and was cut

fields.label: Link
fields.description: Which driver made the provider it came in on; 0 for a mirror

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: The provider's address on that link; for a mirror the board

fields.label: Message
fields.description: The message's bytes (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Subscribe to a stream
commands.description: The peer that sends it gets the stream's frames, until UNSUBSCRIBE or its session ends.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector

commands.label: Unsubscribe from a stream
commands.description: Ends the subscription of the peer that sends it.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The connector

commands.label: Mirror a stream of another board
commands.description: Makes the stream the mirror of a stream of another board: what that board sends there comes in here and goes to every target of this one. Remote stream 0 ends the mirror.

fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The local connector, created before

fields.label: Board
fields.description: The board whose stream it mirrors

fields.label: Remote connector
fields.description: Its connector there; 0 ends the mirror
